name: Experiment Tracking & Model Registry Platforms
description: Logging parameters, metrics, and artifacts across distributed runs (MLflow, Weights & Biases, Comet), model signatures, Model Registry versioning, and stage transition workflows.

subskills.name: MLflow Tracking Server & Remote Backend Architecture
subskills.description: Configuring central MLflow Tracking Server with PostgreSQL backend store and S3/GCS artifact root, authentication, and team tenancy.

subskills.name: Experiment Logging (Parameters, Metrics, Artifacts)
subskills.description: mlflow.start_run(), mlflow.log_params(), mlflow.log_metrics() with step history, autologging (PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost), and artifact upload.

subskills.name: Model Signatures, Input Examples & Schemas
subskills.description: Enforcing MLflow model signatures (ColSpec, TensorSpec), input examples, schema validation, and preventing training-serving signature mismatches.

subskills.name: MLflow Model Registry & Stage Transitions
subskills.description: Registering models, semantic versioning, stage transitions (None -> Staging -> Production -> Archived), aliases, and model tags.

subskills.name: Weights & Biases (W&B) Dashboarding & Sweeps
subskills.description: Setting up W&B projects, wandb.init(), wandb.log(), running Bayesian hyperparameter sweeps via sweep.yaml, and team workspaces.

subskills.name: Custom MLflow PyFunc Wrapper Modeling
subskills.description: Subclassing mlflow.pyfunc.PythonModel, implementing load_context() and predict(), packaging pre/post-processing logic into self-contained models.

subskills.name: Artifact Storage Optimization & Retention Policies
subskills.description: Managing terabytes of checkpoint artifacts, S3 lifecycle rules for old runs, deduplication, and automated artifact pruning.

subskills.name: Model Registry Webhooks & CI/CD Integration
subskills.description: Configuring MLflow webhooks on model transition events to trigger automated GitHub Actions / Jenkins deployment pipelines.

subskills.name: Automated Run Comparison & Metric Diffing
subskills.description: Programmatic run querying using MLflow search_runs(), filtering top-performing models by metric thresholds, and automated leaderboards.
